name: Presentations
description: A collection of all the Presentation objects in Microsoft PowerPoint. Each Presentation object represents a presentation that's currently open in PowerPoint.
remarks: The Presentations collection doesn't include open add-ins, which are a special kind of hidden presentation. You can, however, return a single open add-in if you know its file name. For example Presentations("oscar.ppa") will return the open add-in named "Oscar.ppa" as a Presentation object. However, it is recommended that the AddIns collection be used to return open add-ins. If your Visual Studio solution includes the Microsoft.Office.Interop.PowerPoint reference, this collection maps to the following types: - Microsoft.Office.Interop.PowerPoint.Presentations.GetEnumerator (to enumerate the Presentation objects.)

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Presentation object from the specified Presentations collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number of the single Presentation object in the collection to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Creates a presentation. Returns a Presentation object that represents the new presentation.

parameters.name: WithWindow
parameters.description: Whether the presentation appears in a visible window.

methods.name: Open
methods.signature: Open(FileName As String, [ReadOnly As MsoTriState], [Untitled As MsoTriState], [WithWindow As MsoTriState]) As Presentation
methods.description: Opens the specified presentation. Returns a Presentation object that represents the opened presentation.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the file to open.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Specifies whether the file is opened with read/write or read-only status.

parameters.name: Untitled
parameters.description: Specifies whether the file has a title.

parameters.name: WithWindow
parameters.description: Specifies whether the file is visible.

methods.name: CheckOut
methods.description: Copies a specified presentation from a server to a local computer for editing. Returns a String that represents the local path and file name of the presentation checked out.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The server path and name of the presentation.

methods.name: CanCheckOut
methods.description: Returns True if Microsoft PowerPoint can check out a specified presentation from a server.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The server path and name of the presentation.

methods.name: Open2007
methods.signature: Open2007(FileName As String, [ReadOnly As MsoTriState], [Untitled As MsoTriState], [WithWindow As MsoTriState], [OpenAndRepair As MsoTriState]) As Presentation
methods.description: Opens the specified presentation and provides the option to repair the presentation file. Returns a Presentation object that represents the opened presentation.

parameters.name: FileName
parameters.description: The name of the file to open.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Specifies whether the file is opened with read/write or read-only status.

parameters.name: Untitled
parameters.description: Specifies whether the file has a title.

parameters.name: WithWindow
parameters.description: Specifies whether the file is visible.

parameters.name: OpenAndRepair
parameters.description: Specifies whether to repair the file before it is opened to prevent corruption.
